name: Vegetation Succession, Disturbance Recovery & Dynamic Biome Shift
design_rules: biome identity emerges from persistent community composition rather than fixed labels
disturbances alter vegetation composition immediately but recovery occurs over time
abandonment may drive grassland toward scrub and later woodland
persistent inundation may shift shoreline toward wetland
repeated overgrazing can suppress grass and favor scrub
fire can reset woody succession without permanently locking the biome
dynamic biome shifts preserve continuity with prior vegetation state
succession never uses emissive or glow feedback
